commands_raw:
The first thing you recognize is a smell.
?> What is it? -> 1a
?> Who gives a shit? Where the hell am I? Who am I? -> 2a
?> Just lay there, catch your breath. -> 3a
name: start

commands_raw:
Wet Concrete. Trash. Something else you can't
yet put your finger on.

?> What kind of trash? -> 1.1a
?> Is it raining? -> 1.2a
name: 1a

commands_raw:
You choose to ignore the breadcrumb trail in front of you
and get down to the real questions at hand. Rightfully so, 
Who the hell are they to try to make you play their 
little game, sitting around trying to figure out
what's what and whose who one little measly sense at a time.
Come on now, who the hell ARE you?!

?> I know! -> 2.1a
?> I don't know! -> 2b
name: 2a

commands_raw:
Despite the curiosity of your first noticed sense
infiltrating your grey matter and causing the first few cogs
in your brain to finally start turning you choose to ignore it.
 Before you are able to understand anything about what's going 
on you first need to just lay down and catch your breath first.
?> Continue. -> 3b
name: 3a

commands_raw:
You try and catch your breath, take a big inhale of that 
sweet ol' thing, air. You will your pons into action and
like magic, they respond. 
?> Wonderful. -> 3c
?> Wait, was I breathing before? -> 4a
name: 3b

commands_raw:
Now that you mention it, no. You weren't breathing. You
did not draw a single breath for however long you've been
laying in god knows wherever you are. 

?> Am I dying? -> 4b
name: 4a

commands_raw:
There it goes, your motor senses are all coming back to you, screaming at volumes that would hurt your ears,
if your ears were currently working, and raising their
hands giddily. Which sense would you like to engage next?

?> Sight. -> 3.1a
?> Sound. -> 3.2a
?> Taste. -> 3.3a
?> Touch. -> 3.4a
?> Smell. -> 1a
?> Secret sixth option? -> 3.5a
name: 3c

commands_raw:
Do you?

?> Uh, well. Let me think...well. No. -> 2b
name: 2.1a

commands_raw:
The answer escapes you, at least momentarily. You have
no earthly idea who you are, where you are, or what you are.

?> Tom Cruise? -> 2.2a
?> Bermuda? -> 2.3a
?> Human? -> 2.4a
name: 2b

commands_raw:
Nominally.

?> Continue. -> 2c
?> Tom Cruise? -> 2.2a
?> Bermuda? -> 2.3a
name: 2.4a

commands_raw:
Definently not. Too pudgy. Not that big into Scientology either.

?> Continue. -> 2c
?> Bermuda? -> 2.3a
?> Human? -> 2.4a
name: 2.2a

commands_raw:
Doesn't seem tropical enough.

?> Continue. -> 2c
?> Tom Cruise? -> 2.2a
?> Human? -> 2.4a
name: 2.3a

commands_raw:
It looks like you've been backed straight into a corner.
With no where else to turn, It looks like you may have to 
bend the knee and attempt to recognize what that damn 
smell is.

?> Do it. -> 1a
?> Do it. Begrudgingly. -> 1a
?> And I'm 100% sure I'm not Tom Cruise? -> 2d
name: 2c

commands_raw:
Yes. You are not Tom Cruise.

?> Ah, damn it. Smell time it is. -> 1a
name: 2d

commands_raw:
That must be it. Yes, considering you can't feel, see, taste, 
it must be that you are dying. 
Such is life. I guess all that's left is to wait.

?> ... -> 4c
name: 4b

commands_raw:
Sure is taking a long time isn't it?

?> I'll say. -> 4f
name: 4e

commands_raw:
Alright. Maybe you're not dying. How would you
be able to have a conversation like this if
that were the case? There has to be something
that displays whether you're alive
or not. How's your heart?

?> Not beating. -> 4g
name: 4f

commands_raw:
Hm. Not a point in favor of the "Not Dying" hypothesis.

?> No, I'd say not. -> 4h
name: 4g

commands_raw:
Wait a minute. If you were dead, Why were you able to smell
just now? 

?> Oh, that's right. What was that smell anyways? -> 1a
name: 4h

commands_raw:
Not yet.

?> Sight. -> 3.1a
?> Sound. -> 3.2a
?> Taste. -> 3.3a
?> Touch. -> 3.4a
name: 3.5a

commands_raw:
Hard ground. You're laying right on the ground, looking directly
up at the sky, or whatever's above you. It's pavement, for sure. 
And atop of this frigid pavement coats something lukewarm 
and viscous soaking its way through the bottoms of your pants.
You cannot make out anymore details of it.

?> Sight. -> 3.1a
?> Sound. -> 3.2a
?> Taste. -> 3.3a
name: 3.4a

commands_raw:
Sweet. Delicious. Metallic. The remnants of...something is caked
on the inside of your mouth. Something that you instinctually
know your entire existance revolves around. If you were to 
be desperate enough, you know that you'd gladly give anything
for a single drop. You know what it is.

?> Blood. I've gorged myself with Blood. -> 3d
name: 3.3a

commands_raw:
Cars. Horns blaring in the distance, a million
tiny voices all having their own little
conversation, those little moving gears. The ambience
of night time town. Where you are is busy, but not 
directly where you are. You are sitauated away from
the noise, saddled in a little refuge in which no one
else dares tread through. Sat between two constructed
titans.

?> An alleyway? -> 3.2b
name: 3.2a

commands_raw:
Hm. It's pretty dark here. As you can't move
your neck you're forced only into viewing what
it's directly in front of you. It seems you're looking straight
up. little white pin holes dotting the ceiling. And though you
attempt to count it you quickly lose track and realize
those pins are stars, and the ceiling the sky. 

?> Okay it's dark out, What else? -> 3.1b
name: 3.1a

commands_raw:
Smells like greasy hand sanitzer. 

?> Hand sanitizer factory? -> 1.1b
name: 1.1a

commands_raw:
Two tall buildings, both about two stories, sit on either
side of your vision. The one on your right constructed
of exposed brick and white filling. The one on your
left looks a more modern establishment, a stark grey 
body with a trim of black at the very top, providing a slight
canopy of protection for your face the rest of your
stiff body doesn't get the luxury of enjoying.

?> Do I hear anything? -> 3.2a
?> What about taste? -> 3.3a
?> Touch? -> 3.4a
name: 3.1b

commands_raw:
That's it. You must be in an alleyway. Sat right in 
the middle of a city,a city that can only be described
as neverendingly restless. One that never listens. 

?> What else is there? -> 3.2c
name: 3.2b

commands_raw:
Not much else.

?> Hm. Well, can I move my head? -> 3.2d
?> What about sight What will my eyes illuminate? -> 3.1a
?> What about taste, anything good? -> 3.3a
?> Touch? -> 3.4a
?> How's smell holding up right now? -> 1a
name: 3.2c

commands_raw:
???: "No, I think I did." A voice rings out from
behind you. But not behind you. Nothing's
physically behind you except the cold hard pavement.
name: 3d

commands_raw:
Despite your attempts to do so, no. Your brain has
yet to wrestle control back over your body, the
war is on going.

?> Sight? -> 3.1a
?> Taste? -> 3.3a
?> Touch? -> 3.4a
name: 3.2d

commands_raw:
Yes, It is lightly raining now, in a manner to suggest
that you're currently in a reprieve from the worst of 
the storm. Your clothes are wet. You do not shiver.

?> Why not? -> 1.2b
name: 1.2a

commands_raw:
No, not like that. Not hand sanitizer, alcohol. Greasy food
and alcohol that's been thrown away. It's likely been 
at least a day since the trash has been thrown out,
leaving it to stew and congeal together into
one particularly unsightly stew. 

?> outside a club? -> 1.1c
name: 1.1b

commands_raw:
Blood. That amazing smell that puts you on edge. 
That sweet taste that even one sip is to die for.
Blood. All around you. On the pavement. On the 
walls of the alley way. Being sadly and quickly washed away
by the downpour that has only recently lightened 
up. Something happened, something out of your control
only made in the most desperate throes of survival.
That's all you remember.

?> Continue. -> 1c
name: 1b

commands_raw:
That's right. You're outside a club, "Hum" is it's name.
You were there, last night. First outside, then after some
words, inside. Inside still felt like outside. And
the two evenutallyblended together, until you couldn't tell
the difference. At which pointthere was only one option left,
a mettalic coffin, but a coffin which prolongs existance,
rather than cements the end. Now you lay, only feet
away from your coffin

?> Can I try and get up? -> 1.1d
name: 1.1c

commands_raw:
Though you will your body to move. For your tendons and
muscles to sway to your every command, but the body has
refused. Your peripheral nervousd system has staged a
coup - the traitors. As you lay uselessly on the floor
you begin to realize what it was that you couldn't put
your finger on before.

?> What is it? -> 1b
name: 1.1d

commands_raw:
You're not entirely sure why your body refuses to shiver,
you can tell it's cold - It's cold like a motherfucker right
now - but you recognize this cold much like you'd 
peek out a window to see if it's sunny or not. You
can acknowledge the cold around you, but you don't
feel that cold worming it's way inside you like one
typically would when a gust blows through. You simply
acknowledge how it feels around you.

?> This is starting to get weird -> 1.2c
name: 1.2b

commands_raw:
Before you can investigate this perdicament you finally 
come to realize what that smell was from before that
you couldn't quite put your finger on...

?> Continue. -> 1b
name: 1.2c

commands_raw:
If only you could grab another taste. Thankfully,
your mouth is already encrusted with the sweet
mettalic goodness. You don't need to worry about
the cold, or the smell of trash, or the lukewarm
viscous liquid slowly going cold and staining the bottom
of your pants. You've must've already gorged
yourself.

?> Continue. -> 3d
name: 1c
